name: EuroLeague
notes: 20 teams in 2026-27: 12 licensed clubs plus 8 associated (3-year or 1-year licences). AS Monaco dropped to the EuroCup; Beşiktaş entered as EuroCup runners-up.
Turkish Airlines' 15-year title sponsorship ended after 2024-25 and was not replaced; EuroLeague says it will prioritise global sponsors instead (SportsPro 2025-07-02).

DCT Abu Dhabi (via its Experience Abu Dhabi brand) and Etihad Airways are EuroLeague Main Partners and Final Four Presenting Partners from 2025-26, a four-year deal whose logos rotate across all participating teams' jerseys (Abu Dhabi Media Office 2025-09-24).

Inaugural Euroleague Basketball SuperCup held at Etihad Arena, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, 18-19 September 2026, as part of the long-term DCT partnership brokered by IMG (Abu Dhabi Media Office 2026-08-24).
Wikipedia's partners section lists DenizBank and Castrol as league partners; neither appears on the official marketing-partners page (snapshot 7 Feb 2026) - unverified.
